answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the umber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission.
